# Erwin Mongui

> Erwin Mongui is a software engineering leader based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. He is the Director of Technology and Software Engineering Manager at Cedar Planters in Oakville, Ontario, and a Certified Artificial Intelligence Engineer (Lambton College, 2024). He has 18+ years of experience (since 2010) building customer-facing platforms, owning architecture end to end, and leading engineering teams.

Canonical profile: https://erwinmongui.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/erwin-mongui/
Email: erwinmongui@gmail.com

## Current role

- Director of Technology and Software Engineering Manager, Cedar Planters, Oakville, Ontario (January 2024 to present). Cedar Planters is a Canadian modular planter company.
- Leads cross-functional teams building scalable applications and owns the full lifecycle from requirements to deployment.
- Redesigned the data models behind analytical and operational workloads, making retrieval and analysis 20% faster.
- Runs continuous website improvement through A/B testing and third-party API integrations, and keeps tracking, security and dependencies current.

## Earlier roles

- CTO and Software Engineering Team Lead, Fincaraiz.com.co (Adevinta group), Bogotá, Colombia, May 2019 to November 2022. Led the cloud migration that cut infrastructure and maintenance costs by 50%; launched 15+ REST APIs on a Python and Django microservice backend, reducing latency by 25%; built Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; hired and grew backend and platform engineers.
- Lead Software Engineer, Fincaraiz.com.co, Bogotá, July 2015 to July 2018. Led the rebuild of the core customer-facing website (+25% user engagement), automated 70% of manual operational work, introduced Docker and Kubernetes and Agile practices.
- Senior Software Engineer, Periferia IT, Bogotá, May 2013 to June 2015. Consulted for Old Mutual (payment microservice on .NET MVC, +50% sales in year one) and Editorial Legis (ASP.NET REST APIs, +40% content management efficiency).
- Junior Software Engineer, Americas BPS for Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Bogotá, February 2010 to June 2012. C# and .NET applications.

## Education and credentials

- Certified Artificial Intelligence Engineer, Lambton College, Toronto, August 2024.
- Bachelor of Computer Engineering, Fundación Universitaria Los Libertadores, Bogotá, October 2013.
- Scrum Master Certified (SMC), SCRUMstudy, 2016.
- Continuing education certificates in machine learning, NLP, software architecture, microservices, REST API design, Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, Amazon S3, Django with GraphQL, and fintech (Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, Refactoring.Guru), 2021 to 2024.

## Expertise

- Engineering leadership: technical strategy, architecture ownership, hiring and onboarding, mentorship, performance management, technical debt roadmaps, metrics-driven prioritization.
- Backend and architecture: Python, Django, Django-Celery, C#, .NET, Node.js, REST APIs, microservices, RabbitMQ.
- Machine learning and AI: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib; AI-assisted development with Cursor and Windsurf.
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Spinnaker, CI/CD.
- Data and search: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Solr, Apache NiFi.
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, A/B testing, web performance.
